plants.text: "total population" adds up "members" and leaves out "potential members", so it is not the whole of total population.

plants.id: potential members drained twice by signing up
plants.text: "potential members" is drained twice for the same thing: "potential members leaving" is a copy of "signing up", so whatever leaves through "signing up" leaves "potential members" a second time.

plants.id: members filled twice by signing up
plants.text: "members" is filled twice for the same thing: "members arriving" is a copy of "signing up", so whatever arrives through "signing up" arrives in "members" a second time.

Community food bank volunteers (hard).name: Community food bank volunteers (hard)

plants.id: willing people leaves out Potential Volunteers
plants.text: "willing people" adds up "volunteers" and leaves out "Potential Volunteers", so it is not the whole of willing people.

plants.id: families in need counts Families Not Yet Reached twice
plants.text: "families in need" counts "Families Not Yet Reached" twice, so the people or things in "Families Not Yet Reached" are counted as if they were a separate group.
"volunteers" is drained twice for the same thing: "volunteers leaving" is a copy of "quitting", so whatever leaves through "quitting" leaves "volunteers" a second time.
"fatigue" is filled twice for the same thing: "fatigue arriving" is a copy of "tiring", so whatever arrives through "tiring" arrives in "fatigue" a second time.

distractors: "families served" and "Families Not Yet Reached" overlap and one should be removed.
"recruiting" should be split into separate rates for every kind of willing people.
